title: Making the First Boss of my Game | Devlog
author: Terrible-Software165
selftext:
Hey guys, I'm making a rail shooter (like Star Fox) and documenting its development for those working on a game who want to learn more about the workflow.

In this video, I'll tell you about the development of the first boss, its design, its three phases, attacks, environment, etc.

**Devlog Boss Fight**: [youtube.com/watch?v=NsZRfjOK\_-Y&t](http://youtube.com/watch?v=NsZRfjOK_-Y&t)

If you find these types of videos useful or entertaining, it would help me a lot if you subscribed, left a comment/like, or simply watched it. Thanks guys!

  
BTW this is made in Threejs, with Claude (Opus 5.5 in this case), the 3D character models are made in Blender.

comments.author: Burning_magic

replies.author: Terrible-Software165
replies.body:
I made the models in Blender (Without IA) but I use AI for the coding. It's not a single prompt; I've been working on the game since February. I share everything on my YouTube channel if you're curious.   
  
I also share free resources (environment assets, shaders, etc.) to help speed up game development :)

replies.author: Burning_magic
replies.body:
Oh you gave me a scare for a second. I was shocked and couldnt believe AI was able to make the models. 

So AI for coding only makes sense since the models dont look AI at all.

replies.author: Terrible-Software165
replies.body: Applications like Tripo and Meshy are improving quite a bit lately, but I don't think they'll take work away from those who specialize in 3D. Most AI-powered apps want to solve everything with prompts, so the quality will always be lower than someone who specializes in that. Don't worry, my friend.

replies.author: Confident-Log1321
replies.body: You wont if you learn to work with AI, by itself ai sucks and can't do anything. But with a human it can do better than human alone. But you can use your existing skills and learn how AI can help you create better models faster with less errors etc

replies.author: Tommymcflurry
replies.body: Try it, play with it, retopo/fix meshy ai crap, make AI rules/skills that uses your workflow, now, anything with it because once AI will be able to make non AI looking models (that's very very soon) the only 3d modelers who will have jobs are the ones who already integrated AI into their workflow, its exactly what happened with web dev, if your job/livelihood is on the line now is not the time to take the high road now.
